app.name: StudyHub
app.tagline: Everything for school, university and work in one place.

common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Details are in the log file.
common.comingSoon: This module will be added in a later phase.

status.offlineHint: No internet connection – the app keeps working locally.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupsHint: A copy of the database is written to backups/ once a day at startup; the last 14 are kept.

startup.errorHint: The local database could not be opened or upgraded. A backup was written before the upgrade. Details are in the log file in the app data directory.

cloud.notYetAvailable: Cloud sign-in becomes available in a later phase.

grades.scaleHint: Grading system: {{scale}}. The overall average is the mean of the subject averages.
grades.noSubjectsHint: Grades belong to subjects. Create a subject first.
grades.emptyHint: Enter exams, tests and oral grades.
grades.targetHint: Which grade do I need in the next exam to reach a certain average?
grades.targetNeeded: You need at least {{value}} in the next exam.
grades.targetReached: The average is already reached – even with the worst grade.
grades.targetImpossible: Not achievable: you would need {{value}}, the best possible grade is {{best}}.

setup.title: Setup
setup.failed: The setup could not be saved
setup.desktopOnlyHint: Choosing folders is only available in the desktop app. The browser and Android use the default locations.

welcome.title: Welcome to StudyHub
welcome.description: A few steps set the app up for you. Every step can be skipped and changed later in the settings.
welcome.features: Timetable, tasks, exams, grades and flashcards for school and university – notes, documents, files and calculation tools for science and work. Everything works offline.

profile.title: Usage profile
profile.description: The profile decides which modules appear first on the home page. All modules stay reachable.
profile.schoolHint: Timetable, homework, grades and flashcards up front.
profile.workHint: Notes, documents, files and formula tools up front.

mode.title: Storage mode
mode.description: Where should your data live? You can switch later in the settings.
mode.localHint: All data stays exclusively on this device and never leaves it. If the device is lost or breaks, the data is gone unless you keep your own backups. No account needed.
mode.cloudHint: The app still works locally and syncs with your account in the background so several devices share the same state. Everything stays usable without internet. An account with e-mail and password is required.
mode.cloudUnavailable: No cloud service is configured in this build. The mode can be enabled later in the settings.

account.title: Account
account.description: Sign in or create an account so your data can be synchronised with other devices.
account.skippedOffline: No account is needed in offline mode. This step is skipped – you can switch to cloud synchronisation in the settings at any time.

database.title: Database location
database.description: This file holds all your data. The default path is right for most users.
database.networkHint: A network drive works, but the app should not be open there from several devices at once.

workingFolder.title: Working folder for files
workingFolder.description: StudyHub stores imported files, documents, exports and backups in this folder.
workingFolder.linkInsteadHint: Imported files stay where they are; StudyHub only remembers the path.

subjects.title: Create {{what}}
subjects.description: You can extend this list at any time.

timetable.title: Timetable skeleton
timetable.description: The grid for your timetable. Individual lessons are entered later in the timetable module.
timetable.abWeeksHint: Alternating timetable in even and odd weeks

grades.title: Grading system
grades.description: Which scale does your school or university use?
grades.weightedHint: Each grade gets a weight, e.g. exam 2, quiz 1

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.description: How many new cards do you want to learn per day and how intensively review?
flashcards.normalHint: Default parameters of the SM-2 algorithm

notifications.title: Reminders and notifications
notifications.description: StudyHub can remind you of tasks, exams and study sessions. The system permission is only requested once you agree here.
notifications.denied: Permission was not granted. You can allow it later in the system settings.
notifications.lead: Lead time before tasks and exams

ai.title: AI features
ai.description: Optional: summarise notes, generate flashcards and practice questions, suggest outlines.
ai.offHint: Default. No content is sent to an AI provider.
ai.on: With my own Anthropic API key
ai.onHint: You need your own Anthropic API key; usage is billed to your Anthropic account.
ai.privacy: With AI enabled, the affected content (e.g. the text of a note) is sent to Anthropic. Before each call you see what will be sent. The key is stored locally in the operating system's credential store, never in the database or the log.

import.title: Data import
import.description: Optional: bring existing data along. The import runs when the setup is finished.
import.formats: CSV: columns subject, title, grade/value, weight, date or title, subject, due, priority. Anki: export “Notes in Plain Text” (.txt), no .apkg files.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Review your settings. Only “Finish setup” creates the database, folders and settings.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Subjects, courses or projects with colour, teacher and room.
subjects.subject: Subject
subjects.name: Name
subjects.deleteHint: The subject is hidden. Its lessons, tasks and grades are kept.
subjects.emptyHint: Create your first subject – timetable, tasks and grades build on it.

timetable.toggleParity: This week is the other one
timetable.invalidTime: The end must be after the start.
timetable.emptyHint: Create subjects first, then add lessons by clicking a free cell in the grid.

tasks.emptyHint: All done – or create a new task.
tasks.calendarHint: Tasks and exams in a monthly overview. Click a task to edit it.

exams.emptyHint: Enter exams and tests – they appear on the home page and in the calendar.

notifications.dailyBody: {{count}} flashcards are waiting for you today.

notes.deleteHint: The note is moved to the trash and removed from other devices via sync.
notes.pickHint: Pick a note on the left or create a new one. Markdown renders live.

flashcards.deleteDeckHint: The deck and all its cards will be deleted.
flashcards.markdownHint: Markdown is supported, e.g. **bold**, lists and images.
flashcards.noCardsHint: Create cards with a front and a back side.
flashcards.emptyHint: Create a deck per subject or topic and add cards.
flashcards.statsChartLabel: Cards reviewed per day and hit rate
flashcards.howWell: How well did you know it? (keys 0–5)
flashcards.nothingDueHint: All cards are done for today or the daily goal for new cards is reached.
flashcards.sessionSummary: {{count}} cards studied, {{correct}} correct on the first try.

files.emptyHint: Import files with the button or drop them here. They are copied into the working folder (or only linked, depending on the setting).
files.emptyHintMobile: Import files with the button. On Android you pick files through the system picker; they are copied into the app-private storage.
files.androidHint: Android: access is limited to the app-private storage and explicitly picked files.
files.noPreview: No preview for this file type.
files.pdfMobileHint: Embedded PDF preview is not available on Android – open the file externally.
files.deleteHint: The entry is removed. Copies in the working folder and linked originals stay on disk.
